npc.oldman.name: Village Elder
npc.oldman.1: The village flame still burns. As long as someone goes down, it will.
npc.oldman.2: The torii leads down. Go, and remember the way back.
npc.master.name: Master
npc.master.1: Never stand still when surrounded. Roll through the blow, then strike back.
npc.master.2: Gold you find is kept for the village, even if you fall.
npc.woman.name: The Herbalist
npc.woman.1: The gold you carry up from down there, I can turn into something that stays with you.
npc.woman.2: Sit. Let me show you what I have.
npc.woman.broke: An empty purse gives me nothing to work with. Go down, come back heavier.
npc.worker_farm.name: Goblin farmer
npc.worker_farm.1: The soil on this island is good. Bring me seeds and I'll show you where to sow them.
npc.worker_farm.2: Pick whatever's ripe. I've been watering since sunrise.
npc.worker_forest.name: Woodcutter
npc.worker_forest.1: This wood gives timber steadily, as long as nobody clears it.
npc.worker_forest.2: Come by any time. The pile beside me keeps growing.
npc.worker_ranch.name: Rancher
npc.worker_ranch.1: Cows give milk, hens give eggs, sheep give wool.
npc.worker_ranch.2: Meat takes longer. I'll keep some back for you.
npc.worker_fishing.name: Fisher
npc.worker_fishing.1: The water round the island is full of fish. A better rod lands more.
npc.worker_fishing.2: Whatever bites goes in the basket. Come and take it.
npc.worker_mine.name: Goblin miner
npc.worker_mine.1: There's stone down this pit, and coal, and gold.
npc.worker_mine.2: A whole morning's work fills one cart. Go easy with it.
npc.worker_kitchen.name: Cook
npc.worker_kitchen.1: Bring good food here and I'll cook it into something to take down the dungeon.
npc.worker_kitchen.2: A full stomach keeps a sword hand steady.
